prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” roofing company for every homeowner — the right contractor depends on your needs (roof type, budget, insurance claim, timeline, warranty preferences, etc.). I can help you find a great match. A quick plan:

1) Quick questions so I can recommend specific companies:
- What ZIP code or neighborhood in Dallas?
- Is this an insurance/ storm claim or a private pay job?
- Roof type (asphalt shingles, tile, metal) and approximate size/age?
- Any must-haves (manufacturer-certified warranty, lifetime shingles, financing)?

2) How to pick the best contractor (checklist)
- Licensing/registration: Texas has limited statewide roofing licensing, so verify local city registration and that they pull permits.
- Insurance: Confirm current general liability and workers’ comp; ask for certificates.
- Manufacturer certification: Look for GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster, Owens Corning Platinum, etc. — these provide extended warranties.
- References & reviews: Check Google, Yelp, BBB, and ask for local references from completed jobs.
- Written estimate & scope: Get at least 3 written bids that list materials, brand/line, disposal, flashing, underlayment, ventilation, permit handling, and timelines.
- Warranty: Distinguish manufacturer shingle warranty vs workmanship warranty. Get workmanship warranty in writing.
- Payment terms & lien waivers: Avoid large up-front cash payments; insist on lien releases as work is completed.
- Cleanup & insurance handling: Confirm debris cleanup and who will coordinate with your insurer if applicable.

3) Red flags
- High-pressure sales tactics or “limited time” storm-chasing prices.
- No local address or references.
- Only one estimate and refusal to provide written scope.
- Asking for full payment up front or payment in cash only.

If you want, give me your ZIP code and whether this is an insurance claim and I’ll pull together 3–5 highly rated roofing contractors in the Dallas area (with notes on certifications, reviews, and contact tips). Which neighborhood/ZIP?
